{"diagnosis":"Batch 12 was delivered with source_tz='UTC', while every other batch is in America/Chicago local time. The silver step ignores source_tz, so UTC timestamps are treated as local. That shifts the batch 12 transactions after 18:00 Chicago time into the next day, which inflates 2026-01-17 and puts 99 rows at 00:00-06:00. The fix is to convert the UTC rows to Chicago local time, which is UTC-6 for all data in this window (Jan 5-18, no DST), and rebuild silver. The gold tables rebuild from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM raw_transactions
WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
